description: Record an accepted risk for a CVE, with a reason and mandatory expiry date. Expiry beyond 1 year requires confirm_extended_expiry=true.

confirm_extended_expiry.description: Set to true to confirm an expiry date more than 1 year away

cve_id.description: The CVE ID to accept, e.g. CVE-2021-44228

cvss_score.description: CVSS score of the CVE at the time of acceptance (snapshot)

expires_on.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required.

reason.description: Business justification for accepting this risk

severity.description: Severity label of the CVE at the time of acceptance (snapshot). Use UNKNOWN if severity is unavailable.

name: accept_risk
title: Accept Risk
